_doc: Native code that the release CLI links (and that LEZ's wallet and sequencer link) which cargo does not build from
crate sources: prebuilt archives that the upstream build scripts would download with no checksum (review-code-ops M1).
scripts/fetch_native.py downloads each archive once, checks its size and sha256 before unpacking (and again on every
later use), checks the files listed below, and points the build scripts at the result (RAPIDSNARK_LIB_DIR,
LBC_ROOT_DIR); `fetch_native.py check-build` then fails the build if a build script linked anything else.
Each archive's components and licences are what releases/third-party/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md must cover
(scripts/release_manifest.py check). To move a pin: change url, bytes, sha256 and files together, and say in
`confirmed` where the new hash was checked.
